questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Carousell Coins' with 'Current balance 0' at the top states the purpose immediately.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: With a 0 balance the main action is 'Buy Coins', but it's a small outlined button while the red filled 'Set up' for auto top-up draws the eye first.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Buy Coins' and 'Set up' (beside 'Auto top-up Off') say what happens.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Auto top-up' is explained by its two bullets and Coins has an info icon by the title.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: The only decisions are whether to buy Coins or turn on auto top-up.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Coins explanation sits behind the ⓘ by the title; the history section shows a simple empty state.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Balance, top-up and transaction history all belong to managing Coins.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: The balance figure and the two buttons carry the page; text is two short bullets and an empty-state line.
